component.name: Recap
component.summary: Record your monitors and get one link back

description.p: Recap records every monitor you have granted, plus your microphone and system audio, uploads them to S3, and puts one link on your clipboard. The link opens a page with a single transport that drives every track at once.

Each monitor and each audio source lands as its own file. Separate audio tracks give exact speaker attribution, because the microphone is one known person and only the system track has to be guessed at. Separate video files exist because the desktop portal grants one display at a time.
